crossRefs.note: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong…
Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter…
It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth?…
“For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.
The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.…
Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom…
I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and…
There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute…
Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and are building the house…
Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and…
The tree grew, and was strong, and its height reached to the sky, and its sight to the end of all the earth.
The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;
whose leaves were beautiful, and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field…

translations.web: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
translations.bsb: It had strong branches, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick branches, conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage.
translations.kjv: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
translations.asv: And it had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and their stature was exalted among the thick boughs, and they were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
